method: Read-only source review of frozen producer and execution entrypoint; no implementation edits, Docker, network, installations or CI execution by reviewer.
conclusion: No remaining blocking finding identified within the reviewed synthetic CI rehearsal scope. Ready for authorized actual CI validation; this is not a migration acceptance result.

prior_finding.description: Validator URLs were not bound to target stack and preservation-only postchecks could pass despite zero new target business records.
prior_finding.resolution: Frozen producer lines 179-220 bind runtime service network, database/Flow environment and published endpoints; lines 557-681 reconcile validator cases, document versions, jobs/upstream IDs, decisions and reports with target SQL and actual volume hashes; lines 725-728 require 14 new files and exact SQL increments. Old rows/files remain protected.

reviewed_controls: Independent compose file uses four plain project-scoped volumes and only fixed postgres initializer read-only host bind. No original SQLite or historical volume reference.
Workflow requires each exact run/attempt/phase namespace to be absent before creation. Baseline, upgrade and rollback are distinct; same loopback ports are reused only after stopping the prior stack.

Baseline migration/bootstrap and five synthetic cases precede quiesced checkpoint. Upgrade and rollback start only PostgreSQL/storage initialization before restoring the same pre-upgrade checkpoint, then start applications and verify. No target bootstrap/application migration or Flow repair step.
Baseline/rollback use postgresql driver scheme, candidate uses postgresql+psycopg. Same synthetic credentials and secret key across restored phases.

30 GiB initial free-space check and 5 GiB checks before/after bounded commands plus 5-second sampling during them; threshold failure terminates command and fails without cleanup. This is sampled free-space monitoring, not a hard Docker storage quota.

Evidence selected by explicit filenames; each at most 256 KiB, final selection including manifest at most 1 MiB/20 files; upload requires manifest success. Dumps and checkpoint file payloads excluded. Capacity log bounded in practice by 90-minute job and 5-second sampling.
Failure cleanup only stops containers with exact current run project label, rechecked before stop. No delete/prune/down or original-data operations.
validation_limits: No Docker, image build, running migration or rollback was executed by reviewer.
Reported unit-test results are implementation evidence, not independently executed by reviewer.
Actual image behavior, migrations, permissions and readiness still require the CI execution evidence.
Rollback restores pre-upgrade checkpoint; neither in-place downgrade nor preservation of post-checkpoint writes is claimed.
This review does not authorize default runtime replacement, backend distribution, production migration or risk acceptance.

skills.reason: Narrow source-only logic review did not require a domain skill.
